Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

3) 25–35m model serving & perf (batching, KV cache, quantization, fallback policies) — Redwood infra/serving
4) 10–15m rollout/observability & SLAs (tracing, cost breakdown, alerting)
5) 5–10m next steps & action items

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Oct 12 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Oct 13 — 09:00–10:30 PT
- Thu Oct 14 — 13:00–14:30 PT

If none of those work, send a few times that work for your ML + infra leads and I’ll coordinate. Please include your ML lead (modeling) and infra/networking lead — I’ve cc’d Vivek (serving/runtime) and Rishi (infra/security) from our side.
